items.text: Settings moved into a sidebar, with a page each for Dictation, Words, API keys and General.
After an update, Voisu shows what changed, and What's new lists every release.
When an update is ready, the banner can show what it brings before you restart.
After steady use, Voisu may ask for a GitHub star. The Star prompt switch turns this off.
A Support card in Settings lets you star Voisu on GitHub any time.
Voisu now runs on Macs with Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later.
Fixed a rare case where a long dictation came out as only a few words.
A quick tap with no speech no longer pastes "Thank you."
A first-run Setup screen walks you through your two free API keys.
The window now has an Overview with your last Transcript, and Settings on its own tab.
When an update is ready, a banner offers to restart and install it.
Informal tone keeps capitals at the start of sentences and for "I".
Informal tone writes in lowercase and turns more chat phrases into abbreviations.
An Informal tone switch turns chat phrases into abbreviations and drops the final full stop.
The check mark after a paste now clears after a moment instead of lingering.
The Trigger Key picker now offers presets only. A custom key saved earlier goes back to Ctrl+Win.
Choose your own Trigger Key in Settings. It applies straight away, no restart.
Say "new line" or "new paragraph", punctuation marks, quotes or first/second lists, and Voisu formats them.
First release of Voisu for Windows: hold Ctrl+Win, speak, and your words are pasted where you type.
